name: Ancient Grove 1
description: Roots a grove on a tile for 45s.  Your group within 5 tiles take 12% less damage and heal 1.5% of their hp each second.  While standing in your own grove, take 3% less damage every 8s, up to 15%.  Leaving your grove resets the roots, and planting a new one uproots the last.  Pure only.

name: Ashen Pull 1
description: Drag enemies from the tile you target, and 4 tiles around it to your side.  Taunts enemies, and reapplies every second for 5s.

name: Barkskin
description: Bark enhances your skin for 45s (lowers AC and raises MR) for every enemy within 2 tiles.  Ignores 8% of all damage, and gives 35% chance to reflect damage back.  Standing in a grove doubles these.

name: Briarcoat 1
description: For 12 seconds everything that strikes you takes 20%  of damage returned (Takes into account enemies full damage without reductions).  Can't damage more than 25% of your max health.

name: Cleansing Rain 1
description: Rains cleansing energy in a 3x3 area removing afflictions.

name: Defiance of Heaven
description: Wards your group (excluding yourself/pets) within 12 tiles for 30s.  Prevents fatal blows, instead leaves aislings at 1 health, with 3 seconds of invulnerability.  Can only cast with someone in range.

name: Heart of the Grove 1
description: Forces the grove you are standing in to fully mature for 10s.  All enhancements it provides are doubled for everyone inside.  Gains max root effects instantly.  Must be your own grove.  Pure only.

name: Seething Hatred 1
description: Taunts an enemy for 5s.  Every second, starting 1s after cast, adds 2500 threat for each point of CON.  Casting it again refreshes.

name: Serene Touch 1
description: Restores 1200 health + 18*WIS + 6% of max mana to your group within 2 tiles.  Extra healing costs no mana.

name: Thornbound 1
description: Binds every ally within 8 tiles to you for 20s.  You take 20% of all damage dealt in their place, until you've taken 75% of your own max health on their behalf.  Allies who leave 8 tiles are released, and those who return are bound.  You can die from shared damage.

name: Verdant Grove 1
description: Roots a grove on a tile for 45s. Your group within 5 tiles take 12% less damage and heal 1.5% of their hp each second. While standing in your own grove, take 3% less damage every 8s, up to 15%. Leaving your grove resets the roots, and planting a new one uproots the last.
